item.title: [AAPL] TSMC likely to book fourth straight quarter of record profit on insatiable AI demand
item.description: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced artificial intelligence chips, will likely notch up a fourth consecutive quarter ‌of record earnings with a 50% surge in net profit for January-March thanks to ‌booming demand for AI infrastructure. Analysts say that demand for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's 3-nanometre technology to produce AI chips and its ​advanced packaging technology continues to outstrip the firm's current production capacity. Its market capitalisation is now nearly double that of South Korean rival Samsung Electronics at around $1.6 trillion.
